answer: Pay agents only from buyer-funded job escrows, burning a small processing fee. A signed job ID releases its escrow once, after the buyer accepts a matching output digest; the ledger rejects duplicate claims under any account name. A ridge map or walnut forecast cannot earn extra money through a nebula of aliases. New identities get no subsidy. Funding another payout requires depositing the full amount again, so paying its own clones merely moves existing coins while costing the attacker another burned fee.
